name: Investigate the Camp

angles.text: As a hunter, you may be drawn to the rumored gathering led by Hemet Nesingwary. There, you can test your tracking and marksmanship in the jungle.

As a dwarf, you may take pride in Hemet Nesingwary, one of the most famous dwarven marksmen and adventurers. His reported presence in Stranglethorn Vale's distant southern wilds may stir your curiosity.

faq.answer: Krazek, an operative in Booty Bay, sends you to find the camp and report where it lies.
faq.q: Who gives the task to investigate the camp?

faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary is a renowned dwarven big-game hunter and explorer. Reports in Booty Bay place him among hunters camping near Lake Nazferiti, and his reputation and connections have drawn interest.
The hunters' camp lies upriver from the Venture Company's mining operations, along Lake Nazferiti in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
faq.q: Where is the hunters' camp located?

faq.answer: Reports say Hemet Nesingwary may be at the camp. His influence and connections make Krazek cautious and curious.
faq.q: Why is Krazek interested in this hunting camp?

faq.answer: The hunters are separate from the Venture Company. Their camp lies upriver from the company's mining outfit near Lake Nazferiti, which marks its location.
faq.q: What is the hunters' relationship to the Venture Company?

aliases: what do you do after finding camp
where to turn in investigate camp
faq.answer: After you find and scout the riverside camp, return south to Booty Bay and report directly to Krazek.
faq.q: To whom do you report after finding the camp?

sections.body: Booty Bay reports place a hunters' camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Krazek has heard it lies along the river, just beyond the Venture Company's mining claim near Lake Nazferiti. The jungle is lawless, with dangers and competing interests. An armed camp draws notice.
sections.title: Reports in the Jungle

sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary may be among the hunters at the camp. The renowned dwarven marksman is known across the lands as an elite explorer with influential ties. Krazek sends you upriver to learn whether the legendary hunter has arrived.
sections.title: A Renowned Marksman

summary: Krazek has heard Hemet Nesingwary may be in Stranglethorn Vale. He asks you to find the hunters' camp near Lake Nazferiti and confirm the report.
attribution: In-game quest text: Investigate the Camp
